notes.title: Update 1.44 released for Windows and Mac!
notes.notes:
We have just released v1.44 for Windows and Mac.

- Just walk over an item to pick it up, it won't be necessary to click on it anymore

- Now a message is shown when the user picks an item instead of a blocking dialog which was very annoying

- Treasure room and treasure village levels are now visible in the level selector as well as in the Wizard's bazaar

- General performance improvements

- Fixed a bug that caused the camera to lose its rotation axis in some unusual situations

- Some translation fixes

- Some characters are now better balanced

- Fixed the wicked door level

- Added a Grimoire of Wind in the Skeleton Wizard level

- Tutorial level improvements

- Other minor improvements

Enjoy! :-)

notes.title: Update 1.38: Key shortcuts for potions
notes.notes:
We've added key shortcuts for potions, so you won't need to click on them during the battle. Just use the 'E', 'R' and 'C' keys.

You won't need to remember the keys. The key shortcut will appear in the right bottom corner of the item's icon. Enjoy! :-)

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28370035/9cc512f3c2efec94bae6bed4a18ad907a9fcd992.jpg

notes.title: Keep an eye on this update
notes.notes:
We have released update 1.36 which adds the new Demonic Watcher creature. Now you can summon this scary floating eye whenever you want, and let it paralyze your enemies. But beware, don't be around when it shoots its mesmerizing ray or you will also get paralyzed.ːsteammockingː

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28370035/827ee02ad2f590647381589ae3f56c4b29ecca00.jpg

notes.title: Update 1.35: Everything under... controls
notes.notes:
A lot of people asked us to improve the game controls. We take users feedback very seriously so that's what we've done. ːsteamhappyː

Now the game feels more like a traditional FPS without losing the RPG essence we want on it. The new control scheme will hopefully be much more convenient for moving and shooting without having to hold the right mouse button down.

Update 1.35 is now available for Windows and Mac.

notes.title: Update 1.34
notes.notes:
We have just released an update which fixes some issues and slightly improves the overall graphics quality of the game.

It also adds a volume slider in the settings window, and fixes some spelling errors here and there.

We are now working on other different areas (such as the game controls) and the A.I. of the new floating eye creature which will be soon ready for release.

notes.title: Version 1.26, new graphic settings
notes.notes:
It seems that some old graphic cards are struggling with the motion blur effect that we apply to the camera (specially with high screen resolutions), so we are adding new graphic settings in v1.26:

- Screen resolution dropdown selector
- Option to enable/disable the motion blur effect

We hope this new settings will make the game smoother, funnier and more playable for all of you using older GPUs :-) Version 1.26 will be available today for Windows and Mac.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28370035/8e1731a276cab59f51b9308df4de305bafd0ea1c.jpg

notes.title: Version 1.25, several fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
We have released version 1.25 for Windows and Mac. This version has the following improvements, based on the users feedback. Thanks to all of you for sending your feedback and suggestions, it helps us a lot for keeping the game permanently updated and improved ;-)

1- Bigger inventory space
2- Mana recovery always active even when a spell is selected
3- No spells accidentally casted when picking up an item
4- Now language selection should work correctly. There was a bug that made Spanish the default language for all users, which was not what we intended to do.
5- Mouse cursor should be restrained to the current screen, for those of you playing in a computer with more than one monitor attached.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28370035/01d3d667ac781cf8eec152184ae34c9c22a067f0.jpg
